# Green Dental of Alexandria

> Eco-friendly dental practice in Alexandria, VA offering cosmetic, restorative, and biological dentistry services led by Dr. Hye Park.

Green Dental of Alexandria is a comprehensive dental practice serving Northern Virginia with specialties in cosmetic dentistry, biological/holistic approaches, airway-centered dentistry, and sleep apnea treatment. The practice emphasizes eco-friendly materials and patient-centered care across multiple service areas.
